name: Bernell Farms
tagline: Farming as if your life depended on it
description: Bernell Farms is an agritourism farm in 601 County Road 673, MI, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
